selected_records.title: HAPACT: A Benchmark For Human-Centric Physical Impact Localization in Movies

article.body:
HAPACT paper targets physical-impact localization in movies

An arXiv paper titled “HAPACT: A Benchmark For Human-Centric Physical Impact Localization in Movies” concerns evaluating systems that localize human-centric physical impacts in film. The available record provides no benchmark design, dataset, task definition, baseline, metric or experimental results. Its performance and the evidence supporting it therefore cannot be assessed from the supplied information.
